name: av_forex_weekly
description:
Historical weekly exchange-rate bars for one currency pair from Alpha Vantage (FX_WEEKLY).
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Time Series FX (Weekly)"} keyed by date, each with "1. open" to "4. close" (no volume). Alpha Vantage's JSON comes back unchanged, including its "Error Message" or "Information" notes; a network failure gives {"error": ...}.
Inputs (* required): from (ISO currency code; default EUR); to (ISO currency code; default USD).
Related: av_forex_daily for daily bars, av_forex_rate for the current rate; other sources: yf_forex_history, openbb_forex_historical.
Key: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY (alpha_vantage.api.key); when unset the 'demo' key is sent, which only serves Alpha Vantage's documentation examples. Free tier: 25 requests/day.
Example: {"from": "EUR", "to": "USD"}
